hub.title: HR hub
hub.description: Policy, probation, birthdays, announcements and reports in one place.

policy.title: Workforce policy
policy.body: Attendance, leave, Earned Leave, goals and probation rules.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Attendance, leave, tasks, goals and more, with export.

directory.title: Directory
directory.body: Find any employee and open their 360 view.

profile.title: HR details: {name}
profile.description: Joining date, probation length, date of birth and codes. Restricted HR data.
profile.probationHint: Leave empty to use the policy default.
profile.dobHint: HR only. The team never sees the year.
profile.shareBirthday: Employee agrees to share day and month of birthday with the team
profile.audited: Opening and saving this record is logged.

probation.title: Probation
probation.description: Track probation end dates and record decisions: confirm, extend or mark for review.
probation.emptyBody: Probation appears here once an employee has a joining date.

decision.title: Probation decision: {name}
decision.description: The decision is saved in the history and audited.
decision.effect: This does not change the employee's account, role or access.

birthdays.title: Birthdays
birthdays.description: Upcoming birthdays of all employees with a date of birth on file.
birthdays.privacy: Date of birth is HR data. Only people who agreed to share are visible to their team, and only day and month. Birth year and age are never shown here.
birthdays.emptyBody: Add dates of birth in HR details to see them here.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Publish company announcements for everyone or for chosen roles.
announcements.emptyBody: Published announcements appear here and on every employee's work hub.
announcements.deleteBody: "{title}" will no longer be shown to anyone. This is logged.
announcements.createDescription: Employees in the audience get a notification and see it on their work hub.
announcements.audienceHint: Leave all unticked to send to everyone.
announcements.expiresHint: Optional. After this time it is hidden from employees.
announcements.notifyNote: The notification is generic and does not contain the message text.

policy.title: Workforce policy
policy.description: Rules for attendance, leave, Earned Leave, goals, tasks, probation and payroll. Changes are logged with who and when.
policy.proposed: These values are proposed defaults awaiting owner approval. Change them here to match the approved policy.
policy.readOnly: You can view the policy but not change it.

sectionHelp.general: Business timezone and weekly off days.
sectionHelp.leave: Approval chain, limits and leave types.
sectionHelp.earnedLeave: How many eligible days earn how much leave, and how each attendance status counts.
sectionHelp.holidays: Locations and how suggested and optional holidays are treated.
sectionHelp.goals: Goal cycle length, risk threshold and reminders.
sectionHelp.hr: Default probation length and reminder days.
sectionHelp.payroll: Register only: no statutory deductions are calculated.

attendance.autoMarkAbsent: Mark absent automatically at day end

leave.balanceExceeded: When the balance is not enough
leave.backdateDays: Apply for past days up to (days back)

holidays.optionalCountAsOff: Optional holidays count as days off

payroll.halfDayLossOfPay: Half day loss of pay (0 to 1)

balanceExceeded.UNPAID_WITH_CONFIRMATION: Allow the excess as unpaid after confirmation

policy.listHint: Numbers or names separated by commas
policy.treatmentHelp: How each attendance status counts toward the eligible days.
policy.fixErrors: Some values are not valid. Correct the highlighted fields.
